_about: Validation corpus for L4 semantic duplicate detection. Hand-written, not generated, so it is independent of the synthetic generator and can be used to check the encoder before the generator exists. `group` identifies the underlying physical work: two records sharing a group describe the same work and should embed close together; different groups should not. Hard negatives are deliberately lexically similar but describe different works, which is where a naive similarity threshold fails.

_labels.group: same value = same physical work (a true duplicate pair)
